mistakes.said: they were pretty shit tbh / a lot of pauses / and deadspace (the 10/10 trials: tenten.pieces only cut silences over 0.45 s, 7.4-8.7% silence, gaps up to 0.43 s). mistakes.rule: List videos get zero_dead.cut_words (no gap over 0.2 s), plus edge ramps: every edge takes in sound still rising into or fading out of its word (within 44 dB of the line's level; at most 60 ms before and 80 ms after; never past the boundary with the neighbouring word or the middle of a cut gap). Each item number gets a 0.08 s beat, counted from the word. Prove it with Apple, whisper base and whisper medium on the new cut AND the previous cut: a word the old cut kept and the new one loses is damage; one lost in both, or lost mid-line where nothing was cut, is the ASR. Result: 10/10 gut 0 words lost (medium), silence 5.5%, longest gap 0.19 s.

mistakes.said: (caught before OB saw it: the backlog reactions) Her clips were cut on the reel's own word times. Apple put 'For 43%' 1.6 s late in C4364's clip, so the cut came in at 2.92 s mid-sentence and lost '43%'. The C4397 bleep sat on 'had the' and left '-ucking' audible. Under her loud music bed the gate's quiet test passed inside 'fault' (a cut at 8.03 s would have halved it), and C4380's beat ended before 'begin.' (said after a 0.5 s pause). His own C4371 bleep sat on the end of 'other,' and missed the 'k'.
mistakes.rule: A reacted-to clip is cut like his lines: edges hand-picked at her sentence edges, then proved. Run _work/edge_probe.py (the gate's verdict, her Silero speech probability and the level every 10 ms). Under a music bed, an edge also needs the speech probability low, not just the gate's OK. Then run _work/her_check.py: whisper medium and Apple must hear the whole beat. Her pauses are cut only where both new edges pass the gate. Her words (as heard) go in the gate script. A bleep goes where the word sounds (level plus VAD; DTW word times run about 0.25 s late), never where an ASR says. Prove it on the bleeped audio: the word gone, its neighbours whole. A reel that is only a song plays its beats whole, with 150 ms fades. A reel's intro music can be as loud as her voice. Before calling a sound her first word, hear that span alone: whisper medium tags music '(upbeat music)'. C4364's first beat opened on 2.9 s of her intro music because whisper base's stretched word times and a level jump were read as '43%'. Apple had it right at 4.08 s.

mistakes.said: (caught before OB saw it: the backlog reactions) Each piece's frames were rounded on their own (n = round((b - a) * fps)) while its sound sat at the exact running time. The picture drifted off the sound by up to 66 ms (C4364 at 9.4 s, sound early: noticeable on her lips). Each piece also read its sound for the rounded length, up to 17 ms past its clean edge or short of it. The music bed un-ducked after his last word and the file ended mid-swell (C4380 R: 'ends mid-word', -24 dB).
mistakes.rule: Any engine that cuts pieces to frames takes its frame counts from the running total of exact times: f0 = round(t0 * fps), f1 = round((t0 + b - a) * fps), n = f1 - f0. Picture and sound then stay within half a frame everywhere. Each piece's sound is its exact length (b - a) at its exact t0. The picture is never shorter than the sound (add a frame to the last piece). A music bed fades out over the last 0.4 s. Check: the worst picture/sound offset over all pieces is printed before a render (brand_react_render: 16 ms at most on the 10-29 backlog).

A reaction is his visible reaction (he looks up at the lens, pulls a face), not only him watching the phone: when her intro's sound is heard in more than one spot (C4404: 19.42 and 32.61), each is a candidate; take the one where he reacts.

mistakes.rule: Never assume one camera-to-mic offset for a whole take. Measure it window by window (3 s windows every 2 s over the used range, against the camera's own sound) and map each piece through that: the MOTIV file can skip (C4400 skipped 2.64 s between two lines and about a frame near 116 s, so his opening lines played 2.6 s off his lips). A rounded offset (79.00) is a guess, not a measurement.
mistakes.note: Tool: scratchpad sync/fine.py CAM MIC off1,off2 t0 t1 step win (the matched offset and its correlation per window). sync_av.py --measure-only fits one line and refused C4400 (residual 80-176 ms): that refusal was the warning sign. fdoe_artzen.py now takes CFG sync runs (from, offset[, drift]). 11-03 AGAIN, C4411 Soufiane (OB: 'the lean guy also the lips dont sync, you have been doing that ... i thought you had a built in loop so you upgrade and never make the same mistake twice'): the CFG kept sync=[(0,0)] on a 639 s take whose mic sat +0.812 s off the camera from 407 to 470 s (a MOTIV skip), so the hook and the next 7 lines played 0.8 s ahead of his lips. The check was 'manual', so nothing stopped it. Now: every render records its camera map and the gate measures every piece against the camera's own sound (GCC-PHAT, FAIL over 40 ms). 11-03 night: the check is a confidence vote over the whole piece and 1.2 s windows (votes within 20 ms). A whole-piece match and an even-count median each read a clean piece as off (C4412 +41 ms, C4410 -164 ms).
